# kion_scope_criteria (Resource)

Manages a Kion Scope Criteria, a versioned criteria record on a scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_scope_criteria" "example" {
  # Required
  criteria    = "example"
  scope_id    = 1
  start_month = 1

  # Optional
  # end_month = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria` (String) The criteria for the scope, as a JSON-encoded string.
- `scope_id` (Number) The ID of the parent scope.
- `start_month` (Number) Start month for the criteria period (YYYYMM format).

### Optional

- `end_month` (Number) End month for the criteria period (YYYYMM format).

### Read-Only

- `criteria_id` (Number) The ID of the criteria record within the scope.
- `id` (String) The composite ID of the scope criteria, formatted "scope_id/criteria_id".
